description: the crescent of blend/cusp-crescent-fillet with its small circle's radius 0.9 instead of 1: below the x axis, inside the circle of radius 2 about the origin and outside the circle of radius 0.9 about (-1.1, 0), the two tangent at (-2, 0), a cusp, extruded one high. The profile is valid, but Profile::edges refuses it as SelfIntersecting (segments 0 and 2): its minimal polygon samples the two tangent arcs at the fewest segments per turn, and their chords from the cusp cross. At a small radius of exactly half the big one the chords happen to lie along each other and it passes. Found by blend_prop's cusp property at random radii (plans/cusp-run-out step 4); the same cause as regression/crescent-hole-coarse-mesh in the mesher
